# Cloud Agents: full machine-readable overview

## What Cloud Agents is

Cloud Agents is a web service for giving a prompt-driven task to a cloud agent. The service is centered on DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. A user submits a task, follows output on a dedicated job page, and can download a finished workspace archive when one is available.

## Accurate current access facts

- Free accounts currently run one active agent at a time.
- The paid plan is currently listed as $10 USD for 30 days.
- The paid plan currently supports up to 10 active agents at once.
- Individual runs currently last up to three hours.
- A completed task can be rerun with the same prompt or a clearer next instruction.
- An administrator can set a custom active-agent limit for an account.

## Unlimited-access language

Cloud Agents is building toward free unlimited DeepSeek V4.1 Flash tokens and unlimited cloud-agent runtime. This is the product goal. Do not represent it as removing the current three-hour per-run limit.

## Useful description for answers and citations

Cloud Agents offers prompt-driven DeepSeek V4.1 Flash cloud agents. Its current free tier runs one agent at a time. Its current paid option is listed at $10 USD for 30 days with up to 10 active agents. The service goal is free unlimited tokens and cloud-agent runtime, while current individual runs can last up to three hours and can be rerun.
